title: Partner LLM Integrations
summary: This module provides integrations for various third-party Large Language Models (LLMs) and chat models, including Anthropic, Groq, HuggingFace, Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. It handles API communication, message conversion, streaming, and usage metadata processing for these services.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM Interface
nodes.title: AnthropicLLM
nodes.description: Provides a legacy LLM interface for interacting with Anthropic models, handling prompt formatting, generation, and streaming.

nodes.label: Process Anthropic Usage Data
nodes.title: _create_usage_metadata
nodes.description: Converts raw usage data from Anthropic API responses into a standardized LangChain UsageMetadata format, including token counts and cache details.

nodes.label: Parse Anthropic Tool XML
nodes.title: _xml_to_tool_calls
nodes.description: Extracts and converts XML elements representing tool calls from Anthropic responses into a structured dictionary format for processing.

nodes.label: Generate Anthropic System Message
nodes.title: get_system_message
nodes.description: Constructs a system message for Anthropic models that describes the available tools and their parameters in a structured format.

nodes.label: Convert Groq API Chunk to Message
nodes.title: _convert_chunk_to_message_chunk
nodes.description: Transforms streaming message chunks received from the Groq API into LangChain's BaseMessageChunk format, handling roles, content, and tool calls.

nodes.label: Convert Groq Dict to Message
nodes.title: _convert_dict_to_message
nodes.description: Converts a dictionary representation of a message from the Groq API into a corresponding LangChain BaseMessage object, including tool call parsing.

nodes.label: Convert Message to Groq Dict
nodes.title: _convert_message_to_dict
nodes.description: Translates a LangChain BaseMessage object into a dictionary format compatible with the Groq API, handling different message types and content structures.

nodes.label: Process Groq Usage Data
nodes.title: _create_usage_metadata
nodes.description: Generates LangChain UsageMetadata from Groq API token usage statistics, consolidating input, output, and total token counts.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Chat Model
nodes.title: ChatHuggingFace
nodes.description: A chat model wrapper that integrates various HuggingFace LLMs (e.g., Endpoint, Pipeline) into the LangChain chat interface, supporting generation, streaming, and structured output.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Pipeline LLM
nodes.title: HuggingFacePipeline
nodes.description: An LLM interface for HuggingFace models running locally via the transformers pipeline, supporting text generation tasks.

nodes.label: Format Schema for OpenAI Response
nodes.title: _convert_to_openai_response_format
nodes.description: Converts a given schema (e.g., Pydantic model, dict) into an OpenAI-compatible response format, primarily for structured output features.

nodes.label: Ollama LLM Interface
nodes.title: OllamaLLM
nodes.description: Provides an LLM interface for interacting with local Ollama models, supporting text generation, streaming, and various model parameters.

nodes.label: Process OpenAI Usage Data
nodes.title: _create_usage_metadata
nodes.description: Creates LangChain UsageMetadata from OpenAI API token usage, including details for different service tiers and token types.

nodes.label: Parse OpenAI Structured Output
nodes.title: _oai_structured_outputs_parser
nodes.description: Parses structured outputs from OpenAI AIMessage objects, converting them into Pydantic models or handling refusal cases.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Chat Model
nodes.title: ChatOpenRouter
nodes.description: A chat model integration for OpenRouter, a unified API for various LLMs. It manages API keys, request parameters, streaming, and structured output.

nodes.label: Ollama Local Server
nodes.title: Ollama Server
nodes.description: A local server that hosts and runs various open-source large language models.

nodes.label: OpenAI API Service
nodes.title: OpenAI API
nodes.description: The external API service provided by OpenAI for accessing their powerful language models.

nodes.label: OpenRouter API Gateway
nodes.title: OpenRouter API
nodes.description: A unified API gateway that provides access to a wide range of LLMs from multiple providers.
